messages:
maria: Morning all — quick async standup. Observed sustained enqueue growth on eu-west-1 GPU lane starting ~08:12 UTC, queue +18% vs baseline. Prewarm triggered and we're using burst pool.
raj: Seen it, thanks. Is this traffic spike tied to the nightly ingest or a customer job?
maria: Looks like a mix — one partner job spiked + some organic traffic. Partner job id job-4721 has larger batch sizes. Link to grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/queue?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west-1 :eyes:
infra-bot: alert: eu-west-1 queue_length > 80th percentile for 10m. Autoscale attempted +2 nodes, pending spot allocation.
sophia: Can we avoid spot dependence for this burst? Last time evictions caused retries.
oliver: Suggest we route partner job to a dedicated warm pool temporarily. Maria, can you open a quick ticket to request reserved lanes for job-4721 for the next 2h?
maria: Yep. Created ticket INF-3729 and pinged cloud quotas: https://tickets/redwood/INF-3729
jen: FYI, I'm on canary-drain rotation. If we need to move traffic between AZs, I can run the drain. What's the rollback plan if latency increases?
maria: Plan: 1) move job-4721 to dedicated warm pool in eu-west-1 (no spot) 2) enable routing to eu-central-1 fallback for non-partner traffic 3) monitor p95 tail for 15m — if p95 > 300ms revert routing. I'll post status updates here.
raj: For the dedicated warm pool, do we have spare quota or need a quick bump? I can ping accounts to request temporary quota increase.
oliver: We have ~4 spare GPUs in reserved bucket but they're pinned to other lanes. If accounts can approve +6 vGPU quota for eu-west-1 temporary we can avoid spot.
sophia: I'll prepare the quantized fallback model (v2-q4) packing config; lower memory so fits more per GPU. Code snippet for routing override:
```
route:
  match: region == "eu-west-1" and job == "job-4721"
  action: allocate(pool: "warm-dedicated", spot: false, limit: 6)
```
maria: Nicely formatted. @raj — can you escalate quota request with INF-3729 and tag @cloud-ops? :thumbsup:
raj: On it. I've escalated and added the justification + expected duration (2h). Ticket updated.
infra-bot: deploy: routing-change for job-4721 scheduled at 09:02 UTC — canary to 10% traffic for 5m.
jen: I'll watch the canary. If we see >10% error rate or p50 jump, I'll abort and report.
maria: Canary started — 10% traffic to warm pool. Initial metrics look fine, p95 stable at 210ms.
raj: Quota bump approved for +6 vGPU in eu-west-1 until 11:15 UTC. Ops provisioner is attaching nodes now.
oliver: Provisioner shows 4/6 attached, two pending due to image pull throttling. ETA ~6m.
maria: Update: all 6 attached. Increasing canary to 50% now.
sophia: Prep note — after warm pool stabilizes, run a short load-run on the quantized model to confirm outputs match acceptance tests.
maria: Will do. Anyone else with blockers?
jen: None on my side. I'll keep monitoring and will post a final status when we scale back at ~11:00 UTC.
maria: Thanks team. Final plan: hold dedicated lanes until 11:15 UTC, then release back to autoscale. I'll close INF-3729 after cleanup. :white_check_mark:
